success.replay: exact stored receipt bytes; no replay flag

success.historical: exact receipt-linked pair; never substitute current room head

transport.authorization: one Bearer header; trusted host credential only
transport.get_content_length: absent or one exact0; no Content-Type

authority.principal_source: current trusted CredentialRegistry owner + current unrevoked Store coordinator
authority.audience: sole stable owner principal bound durably to this company/project discussion room on first accepted append; no caller actor/audience fields
authority.current_auth: checked under registry guard and Store transaction before replay/read and before commit; rechecked before response

identity.existing_owner_note_claims: adopted transactionally at explicit discussion schema setup preserving receipt/record bytes
identity.frozen_message_send: remains disabled; no issue-time command activation
identity.legacy_mailbox_and_planning: unchanged historical protocols, not reinterpreted as canonical communication actions

limits.strict_codec: frozen C01 duplicate keys/BOM/malformed UTF8/surrogates/noninteger numeric lexemes/-0/unsafe integers rejected; explicit UTF16 member ordering
limits.timestamps: UTC epoch milliseconds (2000 inclusive to2100 exclusive)

digests.canonicalization: unchanged frozen C01 explicit UTF16-key ordering, strict Unicode and safe integer tokens, no normalization
digests.record_and_readback_digest: canonical complete object excluding only its top-level digest field
digests.typed_references: exact kind/id/company_id/scope/availability/revision/digest/unavailable_reason; digest binds exact historical record

receiver_checks: Retain company/project/raw command+command ID before send. Never derive expected scope or request digest from response echo.
Strict output decoder cap262144; do not change command32768. Validate closed Receipt and exact expected action/command/company/project/recomputed request_digest.
ReadBack company/project/IDs must match retained request and validated receipt. Validate Conversation and Message separately against frozen validators using independently permitted context.
Recompute both record digests and aggregate ReadBack digest. Compare complete typed Conversation/Message references to receipt and Message.conversation_ref to exact historical Conversation.
Message recorded_author.principal_id and receipt.principal_id must match, but remain descriptive data; they are not authentication proof.
Stored observation labels are descriptive, live_verified false. No live delivery, model acceptance, action approval, head CAS, cursor or snapshot implied.
recovery: Caller retains exact command envelope/ID. No automatic retry, replacement ID, rebase or head CAS. On lost response, explicitly replay same envelope after current auth; server returns stored receipt.
proof_scope: synthetic local temporary Store and verified same-host test TLS only; no remote browser/employee/model/cloud/pilot/fullC02C03C08 acceptance
